From: Alex Geller <alex.geller@nexahealth.com>

Subject: Hosted IO pricing & model availability question

Hi Ben,

I’m Alex on the ML platform team at NexaHealth — we’re evaluating hosted inference providers for a patient-facing assistant. Could you send the standard per-1M token rates (input / output split) for your hosted API and a list of which models are currently supported in the hosted tier?

Quick background: we anticipate ~10M input tokens / month and ~30M generated tokens initially, spiking up to ~200M/month in steady state. We’re primarily interested in chat-style assistants (multi-turn) and want to understand:
- Baseline IO pricing per 1M tokens for your small / medium / large model families
- How streaming affects billing (if at all)
- Whether certain models are excluded from hosted tier or require Dedicated
- Any standard volume discounts or committed spend programs you offer

If you have a standard rate sheet and a hosted model roster (ideally with recommended family for low-latency chat), please send them along. We might loop in procurement — cc’ing procure@nexahealth.com for visibility.

Thanks,
Alex

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and context. I attached a short rate sheet that covers our hosted IO pricing and a one-page model roster (see attachment). High level before you dive in:

- Baseline (per 1M tokens):
  • small-family (e.g., redwood-mini, community models): $6.00 per 1M tokens (input+output split billed separately)
  • medium-family (redwood-2x, optimized open models): $18.00 per 1M tokens
  • large-family (redwood-4x / high-capacity variants): $48.00 per 1M tokens

- Input vs output: we bill input and output tokens separately by default. Example: 1M input + 2M output = billed as 3M token units (split shown on invoice).
- Streaming: streaming does not change token accounting — you are billed for tokens consumed/generated.
- Model availability: most popular chat-optimized families are available on hosted; some very large or experimental variants are Dedicated-only (noted in the attached roster).
- Discounts: we offer volume/commit tiers (see the attached rate sheet). Typical starter commit structures are 6–12 month terms with step discounts at 100M and 500M tokens/month.

Would you be open to a 30 minute call this week to walk through volume profiles and provide a quick cost estimate tailored to your traffic pattern? I’m free Tue & Thu afternoon PT.

Ben Carter

Alex — adding a quick note from a pricing/commit perspective.

- Commit discounts (examples):
  • No commit: list rates as Ben shared.
  • 100M tokens/mo commit: ~12–18% off list depending on model mix.
  • 500M tokens/mo commit: ~28–40% off list with potential additional credits for multi-year.

- Token measurement: our billing engine reports per-request input and generated tokens; for multi-turn chat we include conversation context tokens (what you send) as input. Prefix/KV caching can reduce billed input tokens for repeated prompts; we can recommend settings in Optimize to help.
- Compliance & MSA: we have a standard MSA and can share a redlined copy for procurement. I’ve also attached the latest hosted model catalog (public variants + Redwood-verified performance notes).

Alex — answers inline and next steps.

1) Token accounting for multi-turn: billed input tokens = the total tokens you include in the request payload (so if you send last 6 turns as the message array, both user and assistant tokens in that payload are counted as input). We do not automatically include prior assistant outputs unless they are resubmitted in the payload. Note: prefix/KV caching can reduce input billing for repeated cached prefixes — we can recommend cache windows based on your prompt patterns.

2) The $48/1M figure is for the hosted "large" family and represents the fully provisioned redwood-4x class (hosted small/medium/large mapping is in the attached roster). If you need guaranteed capacity at low p95 latency, we can discuss a Dedicated route — hosted availability is generally fine but subject to regional capacity.

3) MSA & onboarding: link here for the standard MSA and onboarding checklist: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/sales/NX-2029-044/MA-terms-draft.pdf. Typical procurement timeline: PO + signature to onboarding in ~2–3 weeks for standard terms; expedited options exist with advance payment.

Recap of baseline hosted IO (input+output billed separately):
- small: $6.00 / 1M tokens
- medium: $18.00 / 1M tokens
- large (redwood-4x): $48.00 / 1M tokens

I’ll send a tailored cost estimate if you share the monthly token split (you mentioned 10M/30M initially). If Tue 23 Apr 11:00am PT works I’ll send a calendar invite and include our Solutions engineer to run a quick demo of KV caching and cost controls.

Best,
